35568.meaning1: is not found; does not appear (in)

examples.text: [etth'antare pāṭho idha nadissati, catukk'aṅg'uttare pana imasmiṃ ṭhāne dissati, aṭṭhakathāṭīkāsu ca tadattho pakāsito. tasmā so ettha paṭīpūrito]
taṃ nadīhi vijānātha, sobbhesu padaresu ca, saṇantā yanti kusobbhā, tuṇhīyanti mah'odadhī.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso loṇaphalakaṃ gaṅgāya nadiyā pakkhipeyya. taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, api nu sā gaṅgā nadī amunā loṇaphalena loṇaṃ assa apeyyā'ti?

35573.meaning1: bank of a river; bathing place along a river
35573.commentary: (THIa) nadītitthāni gantvāna, udakaṃ oruhāmi'han'ti gaṅg'ādīnaṃ nadīnaṃ pūjātitthāni upagantvā sāyaṃ pātaṃ udakaṃ otarāmi udake nimujjitvā aṅgasiñcanaṃ karomi.

examples.text: aggiṃ candañ'ca sūriyañ'ca, devatā ca namassi'haṃ, nadītitthāni gantvāna, udakaṃ oruhāmi'haṃ.

35574.meaning1: riverside; bank of a river; shore

examples.text: divāvihārā nikkhamma, gijjhakūṭamhi pabbate, nāgaṃ ogāham'uttiṇṇaṃ, nadītīramhi addasaṃ.
seyyathā'pi nāma kotthu nadītīre macche maggayamāno jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati apajjhāyati.

35575.meaning2: place in accessible because of a rivers

35577.commentary: (VINa) nadīpāran'ti ettha pārayatī'ti pārā. kiṃ pārayati? nadiṃ. nadiyā pārā nadīpārā, taṃ nadīpāraṃ, nadiṃ ajjhottharamānan'ti attho. ettha ca nadiyā lakkhaṇaṃ nadīnimitte vuttanayam'eva.

35578.meaning1: river mouth; (comm) place where two bodies of water meet
35578.commentary: (ANa) nadīmukhe'ti dvinnaṃ nadīnaṃ samāgataṭṭhāne. desanāmattam'ev'etaṃ, dvinnaṃ kandarānaṃ, dvinnaṃ udakānaṃ, samuddassa ca, loṇiyā ca, samuddassa ca nadiyā cā'ti etesam'pi yassa kassaci samāgataṭṭhānaṃ, aññam'pi tathārūpaṃ udakaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nadīmukhe khippaṃ uḍḍeyya bahūnaṃ macchānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya byasanāya, evam'evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, makkhali moghapuriso manussakhippaṃ maññe loke uppanno bahūnaṃ sattānaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya anayāya byasanāyā'ti.

35581.meaning1: stream of a river; river current

examples.text: evam'evā'ti etthā'pi idaṃ opammasaṃsandanaṃ, sālalaṭṭhi viya attabhāvo, nadīsotaṃ viya saṃsārasotaṃ, pāraṃ gantu'kāmapuriso viya yog'āvacaro, bahiddhā suparikammakatakālo viya chasu dvāresu saṃvarassa paccupaṭṭhitakālo, anto suvisodhitabhāvo viya abbhantare parisuddhasīlabhāvo, phiy'ārittabandhanaṃ viya kāyikacetasika-vīriya-karaṇaṃ, sotthinā pārimatīragamanaṃ viya anupubbena sīlaṃ pūretvā samādhiṃ pūretvā paññaṃ pūretvā nibbānagamanaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

35583.meaning1: river that is hard to cross; inaccessible river
35583.commentary: (ANa) nadīviduggan'ti nadīnaṃ duggamaṭṭhānaṃ antaradīpakaṃ, yattha sakkā hoti dvīhi'pi tīhi'pi jaṅghasahassehi saddhiṃ nilīyituṃ

examples.text: kathañ'ca, bhikkhave, mahācoro visamanissito hoti? idha, bhikkhave, mahācoro nadīviduggaṃ vā nissito hoti pabbatavisamaṃ vā.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso jar'udapānaṃ vā olokeyya pabbatavisamaṃ vā nadīviduggaṃ vā, apakass'eva kāyaṃ, apakassa cittaṃ
suvīraṃ susīmañ'c'eva, dhaj'aggaṃ vepacittino, subhāsitaṃ jayañ'c'eva, kulāvakaṃ nadubbhiyaṃ, verocana asur'indo, isayo araññakañ'c'eva, isayo ca samuddakā'ti.

35588.synonym: ābaddha, gathita, gadhita, ganthita, parikkhitta, baddha, saññutta, saṃyutta, sita

examples.text: gūthabhaste taconaddhe, uragaṇḍipisācini, nava sotāni te kāye, yāni sandanti sabbadā.

35589.commentary: (DHPa) naddhin'ti nayhanabhāvena pavattaṃ kodhaṃ. (SNa) naddhin'ti upanāhaṃ, pubbakāle kodho, aparakāle upanāho'ti evaṃ pavattaṃ balavakodhan'ti attho.

examples.text: chetvā naddhiṃ varattañ'ca, sandānaṃ sah'anukkamaṃ, ukkhittapalighaṃ buddhaṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

35590.meaning1: not one's daughter before; not previously one's daughter

examples.text: attani ca, bhikkhave, attaniye ca saccato thetato anupalabbhamāne, yam'pi taṃ diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, so loko so attā, so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo, sassatisamaṃ tath'eva ṭhassāmī'ti, nan'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kevalo paripūro bāladhammo'ti?

35593.synonym: akanta, akantiya, aniṭṭha, appiya, appiyarūpa, amanāpa, amanāpika, amanāpiya, kadariya, paṭikūla, paṭikkūla, lūkhasa

examples.text: cattāri ṭhānāni naro pamatto, āpajjati paradār'ūpasevī, apuññalābhaṃ nanikāmaseyyaṃ, nindaṃ tatīyaṃ nirayaṃ catutthaṃ.

35594.grammar: ind, interr, from na nu, neg
35594.meaning1: surely?; but wouldn't?; is it true?; wasn't?

examples.text: nanu te, sāriputta, channena bhikkhunā sammukhā'y'eva anupavajjatā byākatā'ti?
alaṃ, ānanda, mā soci mā paridevi nanu etaṃ, ānanda, mayā paṭikacc'eva akkhātaṃ sabbeh'eva piyehi manāpehi nānābhāvo vinābhāvo aññathābhāvo

35595.meaning1: rag; strip of cloth; (comm) frayed old cloth

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, bhikkhu paṃsukūliko rathiyāya nantakaṃ disvā vāmena pādena niggaṇhitvā dakkhiṇena pādena pattharitvā, yo tattha sāro taṃ paripātetvā ādāya pakkameyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, caṇḍālakumārako vā caṇḍālakumārikā vā kaḷopihattho nantakavāsī gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisanto nīcacittaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhapetvā pavisati.

35596.meaning1: wearing worn out old rags; dressed in tatters

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhante, caṇḍālakumārako vā caṇḍālakumārikā vā kaḷopihattho nantakavāsī gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā pavisanto nīcacittaṃ'y'eva upaṭṭhapetvā pavisati.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho nando devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

35598.meaning1: name of an ascetic; Nanda Vaccha

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, nando vaccho, kiso saṃkicco, makkhali gosālo, etehi, bho gotama, acelakā mutt'ācārā hatth'āpalekhanā naehibhaddantikā natiṭṭhabhaddantikā na abhihaṭaṃ na uddissakataṃ na nimantanaṃ sādiyanti
tatr'idaṃ, bhante, pūraṇena kassapena paramasukk'ābhijāti paññattā, nando vaccho kiso saṃkicco makkhali gosālo. pūraṇena, bhante, kassapena imā chaḷabhijātiyo paññattā'ti.
tena kho pana samayena nando gopālako bhagavato avidūre ṭhito hoti.
